target.title: chore(acpx): consume grok-build ACPX built-in
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`grok-build` is now a real ACPX built-in agent in [openclaw/acpx#426](https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/pull/426), merged and released in `acpx@0.12.0`.

This OpenClaw PR consumes that ACPX release and updates the OpenClaw-facing ACP/ACPX/coding-agent guidance so operators can select the real `grok-build` ACPX target instead of treating Grok Build as a docs-only or custom harness path.

Closes #99191

## What Changed

- Bumped the bundled ACPX dependency from `acpx@0.11.2` to `acpx@0.12.0`.
- Updated `pnpm-lock.yaml` for that dependency change.
- Updated ACP docs, ACPX README, and the `coding-agent` skill to reference `grok-build` as the ACPX target.
- Removed the earlier model-selector framing. `grok-build` is the ACPX agent name, not a public model selector.
- Updated ACPX runtime/test coverage for the `acpx@0.12.0` wrapper lease shape:
  - lease identity may be passed through wrapper args rather than env-only;
  - Codex wrapper generic `Internal error` diagnostics still recover the redacted stderr tail through the persisted lease/session identity.

## Why This Shape

The implementation belongs in ACPX, and it has already landed there:

- [openclaw/acpx#426](https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/pull/426) adds `grok-build -> grok agent stdio`.
- The ACPX PR includes live Grok proof with `XAI_API_KEY` and no secret output.
- This OpenClaw PR is the OpenClaw-side consumption/alignment layer: dependency bump plus docs/skill/runtime compatibility.

## Evidence

Current head: `f86e0d1679`

```text
git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD
 docs/tools/acp-agents.md            |  7 +++++++
 extensions/acpx/README.md           |  4 ++++
 extensions/acpx/npm-shrinkwrap.json | 27 ++++++++----------------
 extensions/acpx/package.json        |  2 +-
 extensions/acpx/src/runtime.test.ts |  6 ++++--
 extensions/acpx/src/runtime.ts      | 41 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++---
 pnpm-lock.yaml                      | 34 +++++++++++++++---------------
 skills/coding-agent/SKILL.md        |  3 +++
 8 files changed, 84 insertions(+), 40 deletions(-)
```

Validation:

```text
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
Result: passed.

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/acpx/index.test.ts extensions/acpx/src/service.test.ts extensions/acpx/src/runtime.test.ts
Result: passed, 3 files, 79 tests.

pnpm deps:shrinkwrap:check
Result: passed.

openclaw-autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main --engine codex --thinking high
Result: clean, no accepted/actionable findings; overall patch is correct (0.78).
```

Proof level claimed:

- `implemented`
- `test_proven` for the OpenClaw ACPX runtime/doc/skill alignment in this PR
- `code_proven` that the dependency change is the intended `acpx@0.12.0` consumption path

Not claimed:

- No new live Grok/OpenClaw end-to-end smoke was run in this PR.
- The live Grok ACP proof remains the one attached to [openclaw/acpx#426](https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/pull/426).

## Dependency Statement

This PR intentionally changes dependency-related files:

- `extensions/acpx/package.json`
- `extensions/acpx/npm-shrinkwrap.json`
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`

Reason: consume the merged/released ACPX `grok-build` built-in from `acpx@0.12.0`.

The dependency-guard comment is therefore expected and should be reviewed as an intentional ACPX release bump, not an accidental lockfile drift.

## Scope Statement

This PR is separate from:

- PR #99088 for xAI realtime voice.
- The separate xAI streaming TTS branch.

It does not add model-provider auth, xAI realtime voice behavior, TTS behavior, or new OpenClaw model-lane defaults.
